2024-06-29
Reported a rear-end collision at a signalled intersection and the claimant said the other vehicle struck the rear
bumper while stopped. The claimant reported a knee injury and no lawyer is involved.
2024-07-22
Obtained photos of both vehicles and the police report, which lists the claimant as a passenger in the vehicle at the
time. The rear damage on the claimant's car lines up with the impact described.
2024-07-29
Spoke with the other driver, who independently confirmed the stop and the rear impact. Two witnesses at the scene
also gave statements that match the sequence of events.
2024-09-07
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was active at the time of loss. Nothing in the
vehicle history or the file suggests the damage predates the coverage start.
2024-10-21
Reviewed the claimant's medical records, which describe a knee injury consistent with this type of collision.
Treatment has continued somwehat longer than is typical for this injury, so I've requested the treating provider's notes
on the recovery plan.
2025-01-29
The claimant has no record of prior injury to the same knee and reported none during the interview. Prior vehicle
damage was also checked and none is on file for this car.
2025-02-03
Each conversation with the claimant has prodcued the same account of the collision, including the stop, the impact,
and the sequence afterward. No discrepancies have come up, and the file is ready for the coverage and damages
review.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
